paragraphs: ProudCity sells a platform that local governments use to launch and manage digital government operations. The about page lists websites, meetings, online forms and payments among what the platform covers. A homepage heading describes the product as local government digital solutions.

The homepage introduces the organizations it features as local government partners. The same page states that the platform is WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliant and device responsive. Resources offered there include a guide to buying local government websites and a local government website buying template.

The about page frames the company as a government service provider with a duty to give governments sustainable, flexible technology. It also describes a network built with government partners to improve the platform for them and the people they serve. Both pages cite the GovTech 100 list from Government Technology as recognition the company has received.

quote.text: Open is at the core of ProudCity. As government service providers, it is our duty to ensure governments get the most sustainable, flexible technology available, so that they can best serve their communities.
